## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or contributors.

## Validation

List the exact commands executed and their results. Identify the source
revision for audit, runtime, export or release evidence. State failed,
skipped or unavailable checks explicitly.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe any public interface, dependency, policy, data or operator impact.
Link the owning component and issue where applicable. Source changes do not
authorize installed-service activation or release promotion.
